text: While the current analysis didn’t identify a specific step that would automatically change the decision, there are still practical moves you can take to strengthen your overall credit profile and improve future approval chances. Focus on reducing any outstanding balances to lower your credit‑card utilization, and aim to keep it under 30 % of each limit. If possible, add a small, regular installment—such as a credit‑builder loan or a secured credit card—and make every payment on time. Maintain a steady savings habit to show financial stability, and avoid opening many new accounts at once. These actions can gradually raise your credit standing and make future applications more likely to succeed.
